name: pt9-move-rift-not-needed
description: Playtest 9 pbd539 (076-079): the gravity-rift rolls were offered for a move (309 -> 207) that did not have to pass a rift. Fix (bot pt9-followups, TacticalController.markRifts): a move marks possiblyUsedRift only when a moved ship's own move value is short of the plain distance (or it leaves a rift); the engine's verdict replaces the legacy move summary's 'any shorter path' mark. Base: move-rift-mark (pbd104@59): a letnev cruiser (move 2) at 203 moves to 205, 2 away without the rift at 204, so no rift prompt is due. (The tactical.rift prompt itself closes once the action is concluded: TacticalRiftKind.obsolete.)
